description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for GET api/Sources/Get. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Lists supplier/source marketplaces available to the user and the current channel. ownerAgent: catalog-sources. supportingAgents: listings. Domain: sources. Entity: supplier_source. Operation: list. Scope: current_store. Use when: Use it to build supplier selectors, map sourceId values to visible names, resolve suppliers for a catalog search, or verify whether a supplier supports publication and Auto Ordering for the selected store and country. Use actual returned supplier IDs when a catalog search specifies a supplier; do not invent IDs. Input: [FromQuery] isoCountry: int?. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. If isoCountry is not sent, use the selected channel country. Output: Returns sources/suppliers with Id, Name, BaseUrl, Site, publication permissions, HasAutoOrder, AutoOrderingFee and other visible metadata. Search terms: sources get. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.
